tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway (lane 39), relative-date parsing. Work entirely inside your current working directory; never modify, create, or delete any file outside CWD - in particular NEVER edit /home/ankit114/repos/gw-diag-snap itself. No network, no git commits/pushes, no MCP or Apps, no skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - measured live 2026-08-04 against the production /availability endpoint: the request field from='in 2 weeks' correctly resolves to today+14 (08/18/2026), but from='2 weeks from today' and from='two weeks from today' resolve to TODAY (08/04) - the parser latches onto the word 'today' and drops the offset - and from='2 weeks' returns HTTP 409. This misled a live patient test: 'How about 2 weeks from today?' was answered with same-day slots. TASK: (1) Copy the gateway source into CWD: cp -r /home/ankit114/repos/gw-diag-snap ./gw (work only in ./gw). This clone is branch prod-truth-2026-08-03, the deployed truth. (2) Locate the /availability from/to date-phrase parser and cite the file and line range in DEBUG-GW.md. (3) Extend it so relative offsets win over anchor words: patterns 'N week(s)/day(s)/month(s) from today|now', 'in N week(s)/day(s)', spelled-out small numbers ('two weeks from today'), and bare 'N weeks'/'N days' all resolve to today+offset in the store timezone. 'today', 'tomorrow', and every currently-working phrase (weekday names, following-weekday vocabulary, explicit dates, month-day forms, 'in 2 weeks') must keep their existing behavior - this is an additive vocabulary fix, keep the diff minimal and in the existing code style. (4) Add unit tests beside the repo's existing test layout covering at least: '2 weeks from today', 'two weeks from today', 'in 2 weeks', '2 weeks', '10 days from now', 'today', 'thursday', and one explicit date - asserting resolved dates relative to a frozen or injected 'today'. Run the repo's full existing test suite plus your new tests inside ./gw and make them all pass. (5) Write ./proof_parse.py: a standalone script that imports the parser from ./gw and, for each phrase given as an argv or a built-in list ['2 weeks from today','two weeks from today','in 2 weeks','2 weeks','10 days from now'], prints exactly one line 'PHRASE=<phrase> DATE=YYYY-MM-DD' using the real current date. It must not call the network. (6) DEBUG-GW.md: the defect, the parser location (file:line), the change, test commands and their output tail, and the note that deploy is deliberately NOT part of this task. Leave all changes uncommitted in ./gw (the coordinator reviews the diff and a separate approved lane builds/deploys).
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_parse.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof_parse crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; exp=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); exp10=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=10)).isoformat())"); for p in '2 weeks from today' 'two weeks from today' 'in 2 weeks' '2 weeks'; do grep -q "PHRASE=$p DATE=$exp" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: '$p' did not resolve to $exp"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q "PHRASE=10 days from now DATE=$exp10" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: '10 days from now' did not resolve to $exp10"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; cd gw && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: gateway test suite red'; tail -15 ../pytest.out; exit 1; }; cd ..; tail -2 pytest.out; test -s DEBUG-GW.md && grep -qi 'deploy' DEBUG-GW.md || { echo 'FAIL: DEBUG-GW.md missing or lacks deploy note'; exit 1; }; echo 'PASS: relative-date parsing proven offline, full suite green'
tasks.verified: The gateway parses 'N weeks/days from today/now', spelled-out offsets, and bare 'N weeks' to today+offset - proven by executing the parser against the real current date and by the full existing test suite staying green - with the diff left uncommitted for coordinator review and a separately gated deploy.
